channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘Wait, what?’ Jimmy Fallon stunned as Houston reporter Lauren Kelly reveals her Beyoncé connection
item.description: Houston TV correspondent Lauren Kelly surprised Jimmy Fallon with her 1995 yearbook, revealing she went to middle school with Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland.

item.title: Woman found dead inside suitcase brought to Kansas fire station, police launches homicide investigation
item.description: Lorretta M Moody, 67, was found dead inside a suitcase brought to a Wichita fire station by two people. Police are treating her death as a homicide and are working to establish what happened.

item.title: Melania Trump to launch ‘IMPERIA’ during UNGA week: Why women CEOs are at the centre of it
item.description: Melania Trump is set to launch IMPERIA, an invitation-only forum for female CEOs and C-suite executives, during UNGA week. Her four-day schedule will also include her Fostering the Future initiative and a White House state visit for Xi Jinping.

item.title: Trump-Xi state dinner: Why America’s biggest tech bosses will be at the table
item.description: The Trump-Xi meeting is formally about relations between two governments, but many of the biggest areas of disagreement—AI, chips, rare earths, electric vehicles, trade and supply chains—directly involve the companies whose leaders will be seated at the dinner.

item.title: Xi Jinping's US state visit in 11 years: What Trump and China's leader will discuss
item.description: Xi’s visit will be his first to the White House since 2015, when he met then-President Barack Obama. Trump is preparing an unusually high-profile welcome, including personally greeting Xi at Joint Base Andrews when he arrives on Wednesday (September 23).

item.title: Trump announces ‘AI Force’, plans to name AI czar: ‘We will not in any way hinder or stifle growth’
item.description: Trump made the announcement in a lengthy post on Truth Social, comparing the proposed initiative with the Space Force.

item.title: LPG Aadhaar authentication mandatory from October 1: What domestic consumers need to know
item.description: Starting 1 October 2026, Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (BAA) becomes mandatory for domestic LPG customers to book subsidized refills. About 89.9% of the 27.43 crore consumers have completed the process. Those who haven't will be excluded from subsidies and must register through digital channels.

item.title: US-China talks: 7 key issues Scott Bessent and He Lifeng will tackle before Trump-Xi summit
item.description: The New York meeting will tackle key trade and geopolitical issues ahead of Trump and Xi’s summit. The goal of the Scott Bessent-He Lifeng talks is to prepare the ground for the Trump-Xi summit

item.title: Who is Earl Spencer? What Diana’s brother claims King Charles said after her death
item.description: Charles Spencer, the 9th Earl Spencer and younger brother of Princess Diana, is a historian, author and former NBC journalist. His new memoir revisits Diana’s life, death and the events surrounding her 1997 funeral.

item.title: Trump defends son Don Jr. after Putin-linked Russian businessman-funded wedding: ‘He paid them back’
item.description: The controversy comes as the Trump administration continues to deal with relations with Russia amid the war in Ukraine, adding scrutiny to any financial or personal links between the Trump family and Russian figures.

item.title: ‘Shame on CBSE’ trends: Teacher claims delayed NCERT books are putting Class 9 students under pressure
item.description: Concerns over delayed NCERT textbooks and a new syllabus have led to the trending hashtag 'Shame on CBSE.' Teacher Prashant Kirar highlights the pressures faced by Class 9 students, citing difficulties in learning and preparation time due to ‘late’ book releases and curriculum changes.

item.title: Trump tariffs ‘unfair’: India will buy energy from commercially viable sources, says MoS amid Russia-Iran sanctions law
item.description: Union Minister Kirti Vardhan Singh criticised new US tariffs on countries like India, stating they are unfair. He emphasised India's commitment to independent energy decisions and the welfare of its 140 crore citizens under its own foreign policy, unaffected by external pressures.

item.title: Ed Sheeran returns to stage after Macklemore was removed and other acts withdrew over Palestine row
item.description: Ed Sheeran is due back on stage in Philadelphia after Macklemore was removed from his tour over pro-Palestinian remarks, prompting Finneas, Aaron Rowe, Lukas Graham and Beoga to withdraw in solidarity.

item.title: Riyadh airport: Explosions, black smoke and flight disruptions after Saudi ‘hostile threat’ alert amid Houthi attacks
item.description: Saudi authorities did not identify the source of the threat or say whether any incoming missile or drone had been intercepted. The alert marked the first such warning for Riyadh since the latest escalation involving Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi group began in July.

item.title: Trump-Xi state dinner: JPMorgan’s Jamie Dimon, Citi’s Jane Fraser join elite guest list — who else is attending?
item.description: The upcoming meeting is set to combine high-profile diplomacy with discussions over tariffs, artificial intelligence, rare earth minerals and other contentious issues in the US-China relationship.

item.title: Iran war sends oil tanker rates past $1 million a day: Who is paying the bill and who is making money?
item.description: Oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz are now earning over $1 million daily due to heightened risks from the Iran war, with shipping costs skyrocketing from $208,000.&nbsp;

item.title: SpiceJet flights delayed at Delhi Airport over ‘operational’ issues, leaving passengers stranded: What airline said
item.description: SpiceJet experienced flight delays at Delhi Airport on Saturday due to operational reasons, affecting numerous passengers. Delhi Airport authorities said that their ground teams were working closely with the low-cost airline and other stakeholders.

item.title: PM Modi flags climate inequality, says developed nations' carbon emissions 6 times more | Top quotes
item.description: Modi said developed nations have six times India's per capita carbon emissions, and New Delhi strongly highlights this fact on global platforms. “And I would say to every Indian: You too say this forcefully,” he said.

item.title: Bengaluru GST officer caught taking ₹8 lakh bribe: What is the penalty; how and where to file complaint
item.description: Accused Mohit Pratap Singh allegedly demanded the money to “close a false complaint” filed against the complainant, Syed Zameer, in connection with pending Central GST dues.

item.title: UIDAI plans to take Aadhaar global — What are current rules for NRIs and OCI cardholders
item.description: UIDAI CEO said his ambition is to make the Aadhaar infrastructure best in class to facilitate the platform's global expansion.

item.title: Advisory not enough? Why India is weighing mandatory cough syrup warnings for kids
item.description: India is considering mandatory warning labels on cough syrups after complaints that the medicines continued to be prescribed to infants despite a 2025 DGHS advisory. The proposal calls for a red warning and school-age children imagery on bottles.

item.title: What is Section 147A of the Income Tax Act? Supreme Court stay P&H HC judgement to strike it down
item.description: Earlier this month, a division bench of the P&amp;H High Court declared Section 147A unconstitutional and set aside the reassessment notices.

item.title: India’s software exports rise 8.2% to $221.4 billion in FY26, US share grows
item.description: India’s software services exports rose 8.2% to $221.4 billion in 2025-26, with the US accounting for 54.1% and off-site services making up nearly 92% of exports, an RBI survey showed.

item.title: India plans red warning labels, school-age child pictorials on cough syrups to bar under-4 use
item.description: India’s drug regulator is considering a prominent red warning and pictorial label on cough syrup bottles to discourage their use in children under four, amid concerns over inappropriate prescribing and drug safety.

item.title: TTD News: Who is Kailash Chand Manglam? ED arrests supplier in Tirupati Laddu ghee adulteration case
item.description: TTD News: The accused, Kailash Chand Manglam, was accused of facilitating the procurement of adulterants and manufacturing adulterated ghee at his factory premises.

item.title: ‘Moving towards aatmanirbharta’: Rajnath Singh as HAL delivers Tejas, Dhruv NG — All about these indigenous aircraft
item.description: These platforms reflect the depth of capability that HAL has built over the years and the strength of the indigenous aerospace ecosystem that supports them, HAL CMD Ravi K said.
